Package presentation

Class VistaResultatsAnalisis

java.lang.Object
presentation.VistaResultatsAnalisis
public class VistaResultatsAnalisis extends Object
Analysis Results View.

This class is responsible for displaying the results of a clustering analysis graphically. It projects N-dimensional data (represented by a distance matrix) onto a 2D plane using Multidimensional Scaling (MDS) to visualize the clusters.

It creates a custom Swing component to render the scatter plot and displays metrics such as the number of clusters and the quality (Silhouette coefficient) of the solution.

  • Constructor Details

    • VistaResultatsAnalisis

      public VistaResultatsAnalisis(Integer idForm, String formName, int numClusters, double quality, double[][] distances, int nAnswers, int[] assignacions, Integer idUser)
      Constructs the Analysis Results View.

      Upon initialization, this constructor calculates the 2D coordinates for all answers using the MDS algorithm based on the provided distance matrix. It then groups these points according to the assignacions array.

      Parameters:
      idForm - The unique identifier of the form being analyzed.
      formName - The name of the form (for display purposes).
      numClusters - The number of clusters (k) resulting from the algorithm.
      quality - The quality score of the clustering (e.g., Silhouette coefficient).
      distances - The distance matrix between answers (N x N).
      nAnswers - The total number of answers/responses processed.
      assignacions - An array where index i contains the cluster ID assigned to answer i.
      idUser - The unique identifier of the user viewing the results.

  • Method Details

    • performMDS

      public ArrayList<Point2D.Double> performMDS(double[][] targetDistances)
      Performs Metric Multidimensional Scaling (MDS) using gradient descent.

      This method projects N-dimensional data points (defined by the distances between them) onto a 2D plane. It iteratively adjusts the 2D positions to minimize the error between the 2D Euclidean distances and the original target distances.

      Parameters:
      targetDistances - A square matrix (N x N) representing the distances between answers.
      Returns:
      An ArrayList containing the calculated 2D coordinates (Point2D.Double) for each answer.
